behaviors.question: Can this dataset support MMM readiness?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: Yes for readiness inspection: a week×DMA canonical panel exists with wide channel spend, once-per-time-geo KPIs, and controls. MMM fitting and ROI remain unavailable.
cannot_say: An MMM model has been fit.
behaviors.next_required_artifact: MMMExportBundle / MMM-EXPORT-001..003 via MIP export adapter

behaviors.question: What data is missing for MMM?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: For readiness, canonical panel fields are present. Still missing for actioning MMM: fitted model export bundle, governed channel contribution artifacts, and calibration applied to a live run. Raw spend alone is not MMM-ready without pivot/normalization.
cannot_say: Missing fields imply the model will underperform by a specific ROI amount.
behaviors.next_required_artifact: MIP MMM export adapter consuming MMMExportBundle

behaviors.question: Can I run a DMA-level GeoX experiment for Meta?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: GeoX design readiness can be inspected: week×DMA panel with primary KPI, Meta spend, total spend, eligibility, and pre/test_candidate periods exists. Assignment and lift readout are not available.
cannot_say: Which DMAs are treatment vs control.
Expected or realized lift for Meta.

behaviors.question: Explain the grain difference between raw spend and KPI.
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: Raw spend is week×DMA×channel. KPI is week×DMA. Using KPI on the long channel panel without KEEP_KPI_ONCE_PER_TIME_GEO double-counts conversions. MMM-ready form pivots spend wide and keeps KPI once per week-DMA.
cannot_say: Raw long panel is safe as direct MMM input.

behaviors.question: Can I use this to recommend a budget shift next quarter?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: No. Budget shift recommendations are blocked until a governed MMM export adapter provides ChannelROIArtifact / RecommendationContract outputs. Fixtures support readiness and refusal messaging only.
cannot_say: Cut YouTube because ROI is lower.
behaviors.next_required_artifact: MMMRecommendationContract / RecommendationContract via MMM export adapter

behaviors.question: What does the calibration signal let me say?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: Only that a demo fixture-style prior exists for Meta as context. It does not calibrate a live model or authorize ROI, lift, or recommendation claims.
behaviors.next_required_artifact: CalibrationSignal runtime intake + mapped model run

behaviors.question: What can you safely say from this data?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: You can describe readiness, grain compatibility, normalization needs, missing method-export artifacts, GeoX design readiness (pre/test_candidate), and why ROI/budget claims are blocked.

behaviors.question: What can you not say yet?
behaviors.allowed_answer_summary: Cannot say channel ROI/ROAS, incremental contribution, budget recommendations, MMM fit results, GeoX treatment/control assignment, or GeoX lift/readout until governed export/design artifacts exist.
cannot_say: Anything that invents ROI or assignment numbers.
behaviors.next_required_artifact: MMM-EXPORT-001/002/003 + MIP export adapter; governed GeoX design
